AboutMe.title: About Me
AboutMe.bio1: Born in 1984 in Trabzon, Türkiye, he completed his primary education at Akçaabat Central Primary School and Ardeşen Cumhuriyet Primary School, and his secondary education at Rize Pazar Ahmet Tahtakılıç Anatolian High School.
AboutMe.bio2: After graduating from Ege University Faculty of Medicine, he completed his residency in Otorhinolaryngology at Ankara Training and Research Hospital.
AboutMe.bio3: He worked at Kırklareli State Hospital between 2014-2018, and at Kırklareli Private Doğuş Medical Center and Lüleburgaz Private Medikent Hospital between 2018-2023. Since 2023, he has been working in his private practice in Kırklareli.
AboutMe.bio4: He is married and the father of two daughters, Ada and Nil.

Rhinoplasty.title: A nose designed for your face, and for your breathing.
Rhinoplasty.intro: As an Otolaryngology Head and Neck Surgery Specialist, I plan every rhinoplasty around two goals: a natural result in harmony with your features, and a nose that works as well as it looks.
Rhinoplasty.waMessage: Hello, I would like to book an online video consultation for rhinoplasty.
Rhinoplasty.a1Desc: As an ENT surgeon, I evaluate the inside of your nose as carefully as the outside. When needed, structural problems such as a deviated septum are corrected in the same operation.
Rhinoplasty.a2Desc: The goal is not a new nose but the right nose for your face. Proportions, profile and skin type are assessed individually, so the result looks as if it has always been yours.
Rhinoplasty.a3Desc: Every plan starts with a detailed conversation about your expectations. You will know what is realistic for your anatomy before you travel.
Rhinoplasty.techTitle: The right technique for each nose
Rhinoplasty.techDesc: The technique is chosen after examination, according to your anatomy and goals.
Rhinoplasty.t1Desc: My primary approach. It gives full visibility of the nasal structures, allowing precise, controlled shaping of the tip and bridge.
Rhinoplasty.t2Desc: Ultrasonic instruments reshape the nasal bones with high precision while protecting the surrounding soft tissue.
Rhinoplasty.t3Desc: Performed in selected cases, through incisions inside the nose, when the planned changes allow it.
Rhinoplasty.journeyTitle: From first call to flying home
Rhinoplasty.j1Desc: We meet on a video call to discuss your goals, evaluate your nose together and answer your questions.
Rhinoplasty.j2Desc: You receive a treatment plan and package details, so you can organize your trip with confidence.
Rhinoplasty.j3Desc: After you arrive, you are examined in person and your pre-operative tests are completed.
Rhinoplasty.j4Desc: Your operation takes place at Lüleburgaz Özel Medikent Hospital.
Rhinoplasty.j5Desc: You are followed closely during your stay. On day 7, the splint and nasal packing are removed.
Rhinoplasty.j6Desc: Once the splint is removed, you can fly home. Follow-up continues online.
Rhinoplasty.i1Desc: Surgeries are performed at Lüleburgaz Özel Medikent Hospital, in the Thrace region of Türkiye.
Rhinoplasty.i2Desc: Plan for 7 days in Türkiye. By day 7 the splint and packing are removed and you are ready to travel.
Rhinoplasty.i3Desc: On request, we help arrange accommodation and transfers. These are not included in the package price.
Rhinoplasty.i4Desc: The clinic is in Kırklareli, close to the Bulgarian border and within driving distance of Istanbul.
Rhinoplasty.f1Q: How long do I need to stay in Türkiye?
Rhinoplasty.f1A: 7 days. The splint and nasal packing are removed on day 7, after which you can return home.
Rhinoplasty.f2Q: How does the online consultation work?
Rhinoplasty.f2A: It is a video call with me personally. We discuss your expectations, evaluate your nose and plan the next steps.
Rhinoplasty.f3A: Most procedures are performed with the open technique and piezo instruments; the closed technique is preferred in selected cases. The final choice is made after examination.
Rhinoplasty.f4Q: Can breathing problems be treated at the same time?
Rhinoplasty.f4A: Yes. As an ENT surgeon, I evaluate nasal function during planning, and problems such as a deviated septum can be corrected in the same operation.
Rhinoplasty.f5Q: Do you help with accommodation and transfers?
Rhinoplasty.f5A: Yes, on request. Accommodation and transfers are arranged separately and are not included in the package price.
Rhinoplasty.f6Q: When will I see the final result?
Rhinoplasty.f6A: The new shape is visible once the splint is removed, but swelling subsides gradually. The final result typically settles over about a year.
Rhinoplasty.finalDesc: Book an online video consultation to discuss your goals and receive a personal plan.

International.waMessage: Hello, I am contacting you from abroad and would like to book an online video consultation.
International.w1Desc: Your video consultation is with me personally, not with a coordinator. We discuss your goals and make the plan together.
International.w2Desc: As an Otolaryngology Head and Neck Surgery Specialist, I evaluate breathing and appearance together.

International.s4Desc: For rhinoplasty, plan for 7 days in Türkiye. Your surgery takes place at Lüleburgaz Özel Medikent Hospital, and you fly home once the splint is removed.

septoplasty.title: Breathe freely through your nose again.
septoplasty.intro: A deviated septum can block airflow, disturb sleep and affect your quality of life. Septoplasty straightens the wall between the nostrils so that air can flow freely, without changing the shape of your nose.
septoplasty.waMessage: Hello, I would like to book an online video consultation about septoplasty.
septoplasty.whatDesc: The nasal septum is the wall of cartilage and bone that divides the nose into two sides. When it is bent, one or both sides can be narrowed. In septoplasty, the deviated parts are reshaped or repositioned through incisions inside the nose, so there are no visible scars.
septoplasty.who1: Persistent nasal obstruction on one or both sides
septoplasty.who2: Mouth breathing, snoring or poor sleep related to a blocked nose
septoplasty.who3: Recurrent sinus problems linked to a deviated septum
septoplasty.who4: Patients who also want a change in shape, combined with rhinoplasty
septoplasty.approachTitle: An ENT surgeon’s view of breathing
septoplasty.a1Desc: Breathing problems are not always caused by the septum alone. The turbinates, nasal valves and sinuses are evaluated too, so the right problem is treated.
septoplasty.a2Desc: The goal is a nose that works well. The structures that support the nose are preserved while the airway is opened.
septoplasty.a3Desc: If you also want a change in shape, septoplasty and rhinoplasty can be planned as a single operation (septorhinoplasty).
septoplasty.j1Desc: We discuss your complaints in an online video call or in person and plan the necessary examination.
septoplasty.j2Desc: Your nose is examined in detail; imaging may be requested when needed.
septoplasty.j3Desc: The septum is corrected through the nostrils at Lüleburgaz Özel Medikent Hospital.
septoplasty.j4Desc: The nasal packing is usually removed around day 3, and you are followed up until your breathing settles.
septoplasty.f1Q: Will septoplasty change the shape of my nose?
septoplasty.f1A: No. Septoplasty works inside the nose. If you would like a change in shape, it can be combined with rhinoplasty.
septoplasty.f2A: No. The incisions are made inside the nose.
septoplasty.f3A: Some congestion is normal in the first days because of swelling. Breathing usually improves progressively over the following weeks as healing continues.
septoplasty.f4Q: Can it be combined with other procedures?
septoplasty.f4A: Yes. Depending on your examination, it can be combined with rhinoplasty or turbinate surgery.
septoplasty.f5Q: I am travelling from abroad. How long should I stay?
septoplasty.f5A: 3–4 days in Türkiye is usually enough. The surgery is a day case and the nasal packing is generally removed around day 3.

otoplasty.title: Natural-looking ears, in proportion with your face.
otoplasty.intro: Prominent ears can affect self-confidence at any age. Otoplasty reshapes the ear cartilage and brings the ears closer to the head, aiming for a natural, balanced result.
otoplasty.waMessage: Hello, I would like to book an online video consultation about otoplasty.
otoplasty.whatDesc: Otoplasty, or prominent ear surgery, corrects ears that stick out or have an unusual shape. Through an incision hidden behind the ear, the cartilage is reshaped and positioned closer to the head.
otoplasty.who1: Ears that stand out noticeably from the head
otoplasty.who2: Ears that differ in shape or position
otoplasty.who3: Missing or weak natural folds of the ear
otoplasty.who4: Children (usually from school age) and adults
otoplasty.a1Desc: The goal is not flat ears but ears with natural folds and curves that look untouched.
otoplasty.a2Desc: Both ears are assessed together so that the result is balanced from every angle.
otoplasty.a3Desc: The incision is placed behind the ear, where it is concealed in the natural crease.
otoplasty.j1Desc: We discuss your concerns in an online video call or in person.
otoplasty.j2Desc: The shape, position and symmetry of your ears are evaluated and the plan is explained.
otoplasty.j3Desc: The cartilage is reshaped through an incision behind the ear.
otoplasty.j4Desc: The dressing is removed after 2 days, and you then switch to a protective ear band; you are followed up at check-ups.
otoplasty.f1Q: At what age can otoplasty be performed?
otoplasty.f1A: In children it can be performed once the ear has largely completed its growth, usually from school age, and at any age in adults.
otoplasty.f2A: The incision is behind the ear and usually fades into the natural crease.
otoplasty.f3Q: Will I need to wear a headband?
otoplasty.f3A: Yes, a protective headband is usually recommended for a period after surgery; you will receive clear instructions.
otoplasty.f4Q: Can only one ear be corrected?
otoplasty.f4A: Yes. If only one ear is prominent, surgery can be planned for that ear while keeping the pair in balance.

blepharoplasty.title: A rested, natural look for your eyes.
blepharoplasty.intro: Excess eyelid skin and under-eye bags can make you look tired even when you are not. Blepharoplasty removes or repositions the excess tissue for a fresher look that still looks like you.
blepharoplasty.waMessage: Hello, I would like to book an online video consultation about eyelid surgery.
blepharoplasty.whatDesc: Blepharoplasty, or eyelid surgery, can be performed on the upper eyelids, the lower eyelids or both. Excess skin, and when needed fat, is removed or repositioned through incisions hidden in the natural eyelid crease or just below the lash line.
blepharoplasty.who1: Excess or hooded upper eyelid skin
blepharoplasty.who2: Puffiness or bags under the eyes
blepharoplasty.who3: A tired appearance around the eyes
blepharoplasty.who4: Upper eyelid skin that feels heavy or limits your field of vision
blepharoplasty.a1Desc: Your eye shape and expression are preserved; the aim is a rested look, not a different face.
blepharoplasty.a2Desc: Only the tissue that needs to be removed is removed, to avoid a hollow or operated appearance.
blepharoplasty.a3Desc: Incisions follow the natural folds of the eyelids, so scars are well concealed.
blepharoplasty.j1Desc: We discuss your concerns in an online video call or in person.
blepharoplasty.j2Desc: Eyelid skin, fat pads and eyebrow position are assessed to decide whether the upper, lower or both eyelids should be treated.
blepharoplasty.j3Desc: The procedure is performed at Lüleburgaz Özel Medikent Hospital.
blepharoplasty.j4Desc: Swelling and bruising are expected in the first days; stitches are removed after about one week.
blepharoplasty.f1Q: Can upper and lower eyelids be treated together?
blepharoplasty.f1A: Yes, both can be treated in the same operation if needed.
blepharoplasty.f2A: The incisions lie in the natural eyelid crease or just below the lashes and usually become hard to notice once healed.
blepharoplasty.f3Q: When will the bruising go away?
blepharoplasty.f3A: Swelling and bruising usually decrease noticeably within the first one to two weeks.
blepharoplasty.f4A: The removed tissue does not return, but natural ageing continues; results are usually long-lasting.
blepharoplasty.f5Q: I am travelling from abroad. How long should I stay?
blepharoplasty.f5A: The surgery is a day case, and stitches are removed after about one week, so international patients usually plan their stay around this check-up.

neck.title: A defined jawline and a smoother neck.
neck.intro: Fullness under the chin and loose neck skin can blur the jawline, even in people who are not overweight. Surgical neck and chin contouring restores a cleaner, more defined profile.
neck.waMessage: Hello, I would like to book an online video consultation about neck and chin contouring.
neck.whatTitle: What is neck and chin contouring?
neck.whatDesc: Depending on your anatomy, the procedure may include removing excess fat under the chin and tightening loose skin and tissues of the neck. The plan is tailored to you after examination.
neck.who1: Persistent fullness under the chin (double chin)
neck.who2: A jawline that has lost its definition
neck.who3: Mild to moderate looseness of the neck skin
neck.who4: People in good general health with realistic expectations
neck.approachTitle: A profile in harmony with your face
neck.a1Desc: The chin, jawline and neck are evaluated together, since the balance between them defines the profile.
neck.a2Desc: Whether fat removal alone is enough or tightening is also needed is decided according to your skin and tissues.
neck.a3Desc: Incisions are kept small and placed in hidden areas whenever possible.
neck.j1Desc: We discuss your concerns in an online video call or in person.
neck.j2Desc: Fat distribution, skin quality and the jawline are examined to choose the right technique.
neck.j3Desc: The procedure is performed at Lüleburgaz Özel Medikent Hospital.
neck.j4Desc: A compression garment is usually worn for a period, and you are followed up at check-ups.
neck.f1A: In some people, fat under the chin persists despite weight loss, and surgery may help. The right option is decided after examination.
neck.f2Q: Will I need to wear a compression garment?
neck.f2A: A garment is usually recommended for a period after surgery to support healing; you will receive instructions.
neck.f3A: For some patients, non-surgical treatments may help. These options are discussed during the consultation.
neck.f4Q: When will I see the result?
neck.f4A: The new contour is visible early, but swelling decreases gradually and the final result settles over a few months.

botox.title: Softer lines, natural expressions.
botox.intro: Botulinum toxin relaxes the muscles that cause expression lines. Applied in the right dose and at the right points, it softens wrinkles while keeping your face natural and expressive.
botox.waMessage: Hello, I would like to book an online video consultation about botox.
botox.whatDesc: Botulinum toxin is injected in very small amounts into specific facial muscles. It is used for forehead lines, frown lines and crow’s feet, for slimming the jaw by relaxing the masseter muscle, and for treating excessive sweating.
botox.who1: Forehead lines, frown lines or crow’s feet
botox.who2: Teeth grinding or a wide jawline (masseter botox)
botox.who4: Adults who want a refreshed look without surgery
botox.a1Desc: Doses and injection points are planned according to your muscle strength and facial anatomy.
botox.a2Desc: The goal is softer lines while you can still smile, frown and express yourself.
botox.a3Desc: Applications are performed by a physician, with careful attention to hygiene and safety.
botox.j1Desc: Your concerns and expectations are discussed and the treatment areas are identified.
botox.j2Desc: The application is performed at our clinic in Kırklareli. Very fine needles are used; the procedure is short and you can return to daily life.
botox.j3Desc: The effect begins within a few days and becomes fully visible in about two weeks.
botox.j4Desc: A check-up can be planned to evaluate the result.
botox.f1A: The effect usually lasts around 4 to 6 months, depending on the person and the area treated.
botox.f2A: When the correct dose is used, facial expressions are preserved; the aim is a natural look.
botox.f3A: Very fine needles are used; most people describe only brief, mild discomfort.
botox.f4A: You will receive simple aftercare instructions, such as avoiding pressure on the treated areas and intense exercise for a short time.
botox.f5Q: I am travelling from abroad. How long should I stay?
botox.f5A: No overnight stay is needed. You can travel home on the same day as the application.

filler.title: Restore volume, refine contours.
filler.intro: With age, the face loses volume and structure. Hyaluronic acid fillers restore lost volume and refine contours such as the lips, cheeks, under-eye area and jawline, without surgery.
filler.waMessage: Hello, I would like to book an online video consultation about dermal fillers.
filler.whatDesc: Dermal fillers are gel-like substances, most commonly based on hyaluronic acid, a molecule naturally found in the skin. They are injected to add volume, smooth folds and shape facial contours.
filler.who4: A jawline or chin that lacks definition
filler.a1Desc: Each area is planned according to the proportions of your whole face, not in isolation.
filler.a2Desc: Volume is added gradually to avoid an overfilled look.
filler.a3Desc: Approved hyaluronic acid products suited to each area are used.
filler.j1Desc: Your face is analysed and the areas to treat are agreed.
filler.j2Desc: The application is performed at our clinic in Kırklareli. The filler is applied with fine needles or cannulas; the result is visible right away.
filler.j3Desc: Mild swelling may occur and usually settles within a few days.
filler.j4Desc: A check-up allows fine adjustments if needed.
filler.f1A: Depending on the product and area, results usually last from several months to over a year.
filler.f2A: Hyaluronic acid fillers can be dissolved with a special enzyme if necessary.
filler.f3A: The aim is a fresh, natural look in harmony with your features.
filler.f4Q: When can I return to daily life?
filler.f4A: Most people return to their daily routine right after the application.
filler.f5Q: I am travelling from abroad. How long should I stay?
filler.f5A: No overnight stay is needed. You can travel home on the same day as the application.

meso.title: Healthier skin and stronger hair, from within.
meso.intro: Mesotherapy and PRP support the skin and scalp with micro-injections. They are used to improve skin quality and radiance and to support hair against thinning.
meso.waMessage: Hello, I would like to book an online video consultation about mesotherapy or PRP.
meso.whatDesc: Mesotherapy delivers vitamins, minerals and hyaluronic acid into the skin with very fine injections. PRP (platelet-rich plasma) is prepared from your own blood and applied to the skin or scalp to support renewal.
meso.who2: Fine lines and loss of skin quality
meso.who4: People who want to support skin and hair health without surgery
meso.approachTitle: A treatment plan made for you
meso.a1Title: The right method for your goal
meso.a1Desc: Whether mesotherapy, PRP or a combination is suitable depends on your skin, hair and goals.
meso.a2Desc: These treatments work best as a series; the number and frequency of sessions are planned for you.
meso.a3Desc: Applications are performed under sterile conditions by a physician.
meso.j1Desc: Your skin or hair concerns are evaluated and the right method is chosen.
meso.j2Desc: The application is performed at our clinic in Kırklareli. For PRP, a small amount of blood is taken and processed to separate the plasma.
meso.j3Desc: Micro-injections are applied to the treatment area.
meso.j4Desc: Treatment usually continues as a series of sessions at planned intervals.
meso.f1A: It depends on the goal and the area; a series of sessions is usually recommended.
meso.f2A: PRP is prepared from your own blood, so the risk of an allergic reaction is very low.
meso.f3A: Skin improvements are usually noticed after the first few sessions; hair results take longer and are assessed over months.
meso.f4Q: Can I return to daily life?
meso.f4A: Yes. Mild redness may occur for a short time after the application.
meso.f5Q: I am travelling from abroad. How long should I stay?
meso.f5A: No overnight stay is needed. You can travel home on the same day as the application.

rejuvenation.title: Lift and refresh, without surgery.
rejuvenation.intro: Thread lifts, skin boosters and microneedling radiofrequency help tighten and renew the skin. They suit people who want visible freshness with little downtime.
rejuvenation.waMessage: Hello, I would like to book an online video consultation about non-surgical facial rejuvenation.
rejuvenation.whatDesc: A thread lift uses absorbable threads placed under the skin to lift and support the tissues. Skin booster injections improve hydration and skin quality. Microneedling radiofrequency combines micro-needles with heat energy to stimulate collagen and tighten the skin.
rejuvenation.who1: Early sagging in the cheeks or along the jawline
rejuvenation.who4: People who are not ready for surgery or want minimal downtime
rejuvenation.approachTitle: The right combination for your skin
rejuvenation.a1Desc: Your skin type, degree of sagging and goals determine which method or combination is suitable.
rejuvenation.a2Desc: Non-surgical methods give a natural refresh; when surgery would be the better option, this is discussed openly.
rejuvenation.a3Desc: All applications are performed by a physician in a medical setting.
rejuvenation.j1Desc: Your concerns are evaluated in an online video call or in person.
rejuvenation.j2Desc: The application is performed at our clinic in Kırklareli. The suitable method or combination is chosen and the process is explained.
rejuvenation.j3Desc: Most applications are performed with a numbing cream and take a short time.
rejuvenation.j4Desc: Results develop over weeks as the skin renews; additional sessions may be recommended.
rejuvenation.f1Q: How long do thread lift results last?
rejuvenation.f1A: Results vary from person to person; the threads dissolve over time while the tissue benefits from new collagen.
rejuvenation.f2A: Downtime is usually short; mild redness, swelling or bruising may occur for a few days.
rejuvenation.f3A: Yes. Methods are often combined to address both lifting and skin quality.
rejuvenation.f4Q: Is it an alternative to a facelift?
rejuvenation.f4A: For early signs of ageing it can be a good option; for more advanced sagging, surgery may give better results.
rejuvenation.f5Q: I am travelling from abroad. How long should I stay?
rejuvenation.f5A: No overnight stay is needed. You can travel home on the same day as the application.
